description: List the organization address book alphabetically by display name, with cursor pagination. Filter by type (person or organization) and by q, which matches a substring of the display name only. Each item carries the names, emails, phones, tags, and the number of matters the contact is the client of. Use contacts.search for a short unpaginated lookup that also matches first, last, and organization names.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page to fetch the next page
